With today's new version release, users who rely on the SmartGym iPhone app will find it easier to adjust and record their training sets during workouts. Details are as follows.

SmartGym makes it easier to adjust and record training sets during exercise

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has always allowed users to quickly adjust details such as repetitions and weight when logging each set.

With today's update, this flexibility officially arrives on the iPhone app. Users can now freely switch between the existing logging interface and a brand-new "inline logging" interface, the latter allowing them to adjust values, record sets and add new training sets without leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small badge to the bottom-right corner of the reps and weight fields, showing the value originally preset for each set.

After completing a set log, SmartGym also launches the rest timer directly on the same screen, allowing users to continue training without switching screens.

Here's SmartGym:

This matters because SmartGym isn't just about logging what you actually did—it's about helping you understand what you should have done.

This update also introduces a completely redesigned keyboard built from the ground up, making the logging process during workouts even more fluid. The keyboard features buttons that let users quickly increase or decrease values, or switch between regular sets, warm-up sets and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is a second you can spend focusing on your training."

Finally, today's update also includes a redesigned "Smart Action Button" that predicts the user's most likely next action, and displays the corresponding action options at the bottom of the interface based on the stage the user is at in their workout.

Options include "Log Set and Rest", "Start Exercise", "First Superset", "Update Set", "Next Exercise" and "Finish Workout", among others.

SmartGym says they have also enhanced the smart computing behind the "Smart Action Button":

The result is a feature that feels more natural and fluid. SmartGym silently handles all the complex operations in the background, so users only see exactly what they need, exactly when they need it.

Last but not least: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's "Smart Action Button", allowing you to manage your training more quickly without navigating back and forth within the app.

SmartGym is available as a free download on the App Store, with a variety of subscription plans on offer.
